title: Core verbs, full pattern
vocabFocus: tener, querer, ir, hacer — every person
listenFocus: A dialogue with a group of friends
practiceFocus: Describe a friend’s plans and a group’s plans

points.title: Five people, one pattern each
points.rule: Days 1–14 only needed yo, tú, and sometimes nosotros for these four verbs. Now add él/ella and ellos/ellas, so you can talk about someone else and about a group. Tener que still means have to. Hay que is the same idea without a person attached, a rule for everyone.

examples.english: You have to arrive early. No person attached.

grammar.notYet: Vosotros (tenéis, queréis, vais, hacéis). You will hear it in Spain; you still do not need to say it.

phrases.english: My friends have a lot of work.
He wants to travel this year.

phrases.spanish: Va al gimnasio todos los días.
phrases.english: He or she goes to the gym every day.

phrases.spanish: Vamos a la playa el sábado.
phrases.english: We are going to the beach on Saturday.
He or she does the shopping on Sundays.
They make a lot of noise.

phrases.note: Tener que, from day 4, now with any person: tienes que, tiene que.
Hay que has no person. It is a rule for everyone.

phrases.english: What does he or she have to do today?

phrases.spanish: Tienen que salir a las ocho.
phrases.english: They have to leave at eight.

lines.speaker: Marta
lines.spanish: ¿Qué hace tu hermana este fin de semana?
lines.english: What is your sister doing this weekend?

lines.speaker: Alex
lines.spanish: Tiene que trabajar el sábado, pero el domingo quiere descansar.
lines.english: She has to work Saturday, but Sunday she wants to rest.

lines.speaker: Marta
lines.spanish: Mis amigos y yo vamos a la montaña. ¿Quieres venir?
lines.english: My friends and I are going to the mountains. Do you want to come?

lines.speaker: Alex
lines.english: Yes. What do we have to bring?

lines.speaker: Marta
lines.spanish: Hay que llevar agua y comida. Ellos hacen la comida.
lines.english: You have to bring water and food. They are making the food.

lines.speaker: Alex
lines.spanish: Perfecto. Voy a preparar café para todos.
lines.english: Perfect. I will make coffee for everyone.

practice.title: Someone else, and a group
practice.instruction: Describe what one friend has, wants, is going to do, and does, using tiene, quiere, va, hace. Then describe the same four things for a group, using tienen, quieren, van, hacen.
starters: Mis amigos tienen… quieren… van… hacen…
tips: Say every person out loud before you write anything down.
The pattern only sticks if you hear yourself use it.
